title: Kagamine Rin — Profile Story

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow, it's fantastic you're all so full of energy!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I was told to talk a little bit before singing, so let me introduce myself!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm Kagamine Rin, nice to meet you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You know, Len and I've been counting down to today using a calendar.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's see... For about a month, I think?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We'd cross out each day as it passed, just to remind ourselves how many days were left until we could sing for you all!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
And finally, that day is here!
I'm so excited about this!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's all have a great time!
